packageRules.description: terraform/version.tf pins the urllo provider to 0.0.1 to match ./build-local.sh's local filesystem-mirror build, not a registry release -- this repo IS that provider, so Renovate bumping it against the registry is both circular and wrong for local dev.
Consolidate every non-major update (Go modules + GitHub Actions, all directories) into a single PR.
Consolidate every major update into a single PR, kept separate from non-major so breaking changes are reviewed on their own.
